rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone or something is burdened by being held back or encumbered.

example.english: Don't burden me all the time—let me walk by myself.
example.traditional: 你唔好成日拖累我，畀我自己行啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 to1 leoi6 ngo5 bei2 ngo5 zi6 gei2 haang4 laa1

rows.note: Use this when burdening someone means imposing an additional obligation, cost, or load, such as taxes.

example.english: Raising taxes will only burden people and won't help everyone.
example.traditional: 加稅只會增加負擔，幫唔到大家。
example.jyutping: gaa1 seoi3 zi2 wui5 zang1 gaa1 fu6 daam1 bong1 m4 dou2 daai6 gaa1

rows.note: Pick this when the burden is mainly emotional pressure or worry.

example.english: This job has been a huge burden on me lately.
example.traditional: 呢排份工畀我好大壓力。
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 fan6 gung1 bei2 ngo5 hou2 daai6 aat3 lik6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a physical, practical, or emotional burden.

example.english: Medical bills are a heavy burden for the elderly.
example.traditional: 醫藥費對老人家嚟講係一個好重嘅負擔。
example.jyutping: ji1 joek6 fai3 deoi3 lou5 jan4 gaa1 lei4 gong2 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 cung5 ge3 fu6 daam1

rows.note: Pick this for the responsibility or onus aspect of the burden, rather than its weight or stress.

example.english: Taking care of my parents is my responsibility, not a burden.
example.traditional: 照顧父母係我嘅責任，唔係負擔。
example.jyutping: ziu3 gu3 fu6 mou5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 zaak3 jam6 m4 hai6 fu6 daam1
